meta.name: higgsfield-product-photoshoot
meta.description:
Generate brand-quality product images through Higgsfield product-photoshoot
prompt enhancement on GPT Image 2 / gpt_image_2. Entry point for professional
brand/product visuals.
Use when: "product photo", "studio shot", "lifestyle image", "Pinterest pin",
"hero/banner", "carousel", "ad creative", "Meta ads", "virtual try-on",
"model wearing", "person holding product", "closeup with hands",
"levitating/floating/splash product", "CGI/surreal product", "restyle",
"seasonal/aesthetic variation", or any product, brand, or paid-social creative.
Modes: product_shot, lifestyle_scene, closeup_product_with_person,
moodboard_pin, hero_banner, social_carousel, ad_creative_pack,
virtual_model_tryout, conceptual_product, restyle. Backend assembles the final
prompt; never freehand it.
NOT for: no-product text-to-image (use higgsfield-generate), branded avatar
video (use higgsfield-generate Marketing Studio), marketplace listing cards
(use higgsfield-marketplace-cards), Soul Character training (use
higgsfield-soul-id).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成品牌级产品图片，用于广告和社交媒体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为品牌或电商生成高质量产品视觉素材
copy.tagline_en: Generate brand-quality product images for ads and social media
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need high-quality product visuals for your brand or ecommerce

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用「higgsfield product-photoshoot create」命令生成品牌商品图片。它会先问你最多4个问题（如风格、用途），然后根据你的描述选择模式（如产品照、生活方式场景），最后调用图像模型生成并返回图片链接。
howto.when: 当你说出“产品照片”“工作室拍摄”“生活方式图片”等关键词，或要求制作产品/品牌/付费社交创意时触发。也适用于你上传产品图片并说要“做图片/拍摄”。

say.text: 给我的咖啡壶拍一张工作室风格的产品照。
say.note: Claude 会询问细节后生成产品照。

say.text: 帮我把这款蜡烛做成 Pinterest 风格精华帖。
say.note: 选择 moodboard_pin 模式生成。

say.text: 这张产品图改成圣诞氛围，安静奢华风格。
say.note: 触发 restyle 模式重新渲染。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude uses the `higgsfield product-photoshoot create` command to generate brand-quality product images. It asks you up to 4 questions (e.g., style, use case), selects a mode (e.g., product_shot, lifestyle_scene), then calls the image model and returns image URLs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like "product photo", "studio shot", "lifestyle image", or request product/brand/paid-social creative. Also triggered when you upload a product photo and ask for images/photoshoots.

say_en.text: Take a studio-style product photo of my coffee pot.
say_en.note: Claude will ask details then generate.

say_en.text: Turn this candle into a Pinterest-style moodboard pin.
Restyle this product image for Christmas, quiet luxury vibe.
